content.text:
I'll help you with any tasks you need. As your AI assistant PAM, I'm here to keep you organized and improve your productivity across both work and personal projects.

To get started, let me check OpenMemory for any stored preferences or rules that should guide my work.

<function_calls>
<invoke name="openMemory_search">
<parameter name="query">preferences rules workflow</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<parameter name="limit">10</parameter>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="openMemory_search">
<parameter name="query">task management advice</parameter>
<parameter name="limit">10</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

I'm ready to assist you with:
- Task and project management
- Schedule coordination
- Email and document management
- Research and information gathering
- Code and file operations
- Time tracking and productivity optimization

What would you like me to help you with today?
